# Third-party components

* PDF.js 3.11.174, copyright Mozilla and contributors, Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-PDF.js.txt`). The legacy browser build, CMaps and standard fonts are bundled locally; their directories contain additional font and CMap notices.
* IBM Plex Sans Arabic, copyright IBM, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`LICENSE-IBM-Plex.txt`).
* Amiri and Noto Naskh Arabic, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`LICENSE-Amiri.txt`, `LICENSE-Noto-Naskh-Arabic.txt`), and DejaVu fonts (`LICENSE-DejaVu.txt`). These fonts were rendered to build the local printed-word OCR template table.
* FrequencyWords word lists, copyright Hermit Dave, MIT (`LICENSE-FrequencyWords.txt`). A bounded subset populates the OCR dictionary. Templates were generated from the listed fonts; no pre-trained OCR or language model is included.
